entries.value: "Screenshot request protocol (#3261): the file-based request/response channel `bsc shot` uses to ask the RUNNING app for a webview snapshot, plus the `bsc shot` CLI. Tauri-free — the desktop app (the watcher/capturer) and the tiny CLI both depend on it."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# Tauri-free core so the lean `bsc` umbrella binary can reuse it without dragging the desktop app in
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# Decode a captured PNG to RGBA8 for `shot diff` — same version the app side uses (src-tauri).
# `bsc_base_dir()` (the ~/.base-studio-code root) + `now_ms()` — the same helpers every store crate uses.
# The ONE bsc→app request channel (#3274) — shared with `bsc navigate`, so there is no second transport.
# The baseline SWEEP lands each component before capturing it (#a-baseline-sweep-walks-the-kit-itself).
# Reusing navigate's round-trip rather than re-sending its request shape — same channel, one caller more.
# Reads the component store directly to enumerate a kit; the whole component CLI is not needed for a list.
# Backdates a capture's mtime so the retention sweep is tested against a CHOSEN age rather than
# by sleeping. Already in the lockfile (0.2.29, via notify), so this pulls nothing new.
